question: Should Discord subagent progress reactions be an independent reaction owner, or must they integrate with the existing acknowledgement/status-reaction lifecycle?
rationale: Both systems mutate the same source message with configurable emojis, and fallback cleanup can remove another lifecycle's reaction; tests cannot select the permanent ownership contract.

options.title: Integrate Reaction Ownership
options.body: Represent subagent progress within the existing Discord reaction lifecycle so additions, transitions, restoration, and cleanup have one owner.

options.title: Keep Independent Owners
options.body: Allow both best-effort systems to mutate reactions independently and explicitly document unsupported emoji collisions.

options.title: Narrow To Typing
options.body: Ship typing keepalive without progress reactions until a shared reaction-arbitration contract exists.

recommendation.title: Integrate Reaction Ownership
recommendation.body: Represent subagent progress within the existing Discord reaction lifecycle so additions, transitions, restoration, and cleanup have one owner.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest history signal spans both the existing Discord reaction lifecycle and the core subagent registry boundary involved in this choice.
